Direction.description:
3'UTR usage-shift direction.

Data Controller Design §5 (E5) is explicit that this must be an
**exhaustive, non-nullable-in-spirit** enum -- ``undetermined`` is a
first-class value, not a missing/None field -- because today's
hand-built `switches_annotated.csv` computed direction ad hoc and
silently dropped rows it couldn't classify (bug context: D8
"direction/omnibus" correctness fix). Every :class:`FindingRow` MUST
set one of these four values; never leave it absent.
Direction.title: Direction

description:
One row of `findings_long` -- the normalized target schema for engine
stage E5, which does not exist in the engine yet; THIS MODEL DEFINES IT.

Grounded in the real `switch diff` wide TSV columns (IO reference §3):
``pas_id, gene_id, chrom, start, end, strand, cluster1, cluster2,
pvalue, qvalue, n_cells, n_cells_cluster1, n_cells_cluster2,
n_reads_pas_cluster1, n_reads_pas_cluster2, odds_ratio,
delta_proportion, log2fc`` -- reshaped to long format (one row per PAS x
comparison x strategy), keyed by the minted ``pas_uid``/
``canonical_cluster`` (spec §7g), with ``direction`` added (never
silently NA, Data Controller Design D8).

Deliberately NOT included: ``chrom/start/end/strand``. Per spec §7d,
coordinates must always be sourced from `pasbed.bed` / the pas ledger
(join on ``pas_uid``), never duplicated onto a findings row -- that
duplication is exactly how bug B4 (blank/stale coords in switch
diff/length TSVs after a layout change) happened in the first place.

arm.description: Analysis/arm identifier (Data Controller Design §4a 'Analysis(arm)'), e.g. a switch-diff run/config label.
arm.title: Arm

canonical_cluster.description: This row's subject cluster, cross-sample comparable (post-B6 canonical_cluster round-trip) -- never a raw per-sample leiden label.
canonical_cluster.title: Canonical Cluster

celltype.description: GEX-derived cell type label, resolved via RunManifest.stratum_to_label (never a raw/truncated directory name, D10). Gated on roadmap item A1 (ema celltype does not exist yet, spec §7c); always None until then.
celltype.title: Celltype

comparison_cluster.description: The partner cluster for a pairwise comparison (fisher/nb_pairwise). None for nb_multi omnibus rows, which have no single partner.
comparison_cluster.title: Comparison Cluster

delta_proportion.description: NOT 'delta_p' -- see research_stats_validity_bugs: this is a proportion delta, not a p-value delta.
delta_proportion.title: Delta Proportion

direction.description: Never silently absent -- one of shorten/lengthen/flat/undetermined (D8/E5).

finding_uid.description: Minted via ids.finding_uid(resolved_label, var_name, strategy, arm, pas_uid).
finding_uid.title: Finding Uid

gene_id.description: Ensembl gene id, sourced from PasLedgerRow.gene_id (never var['gene_id'], B7).
gene_id.title: Gene Id

log2fc.description: NB-strategy log2 fold change; may be None for fisher rows that only report odds_ratio.
log2fc.title: Log2Fc

n_cells.description: Total cells tested across canonical_cluster (+ comparison_cluster if pairwise).
n_cells.title: N Cells

n_cells_comparison.description: Cells in comparison_cluster specifically, if pairwise.
n_cells_comparison.title: N Cells Comparison

n_cells_subject.description: Cells in canonical_cluster specifically (parity with n_cells_cluster1/2).
n_cells_subject.title: N Cells Subject

n_reads.description: Total reads at this PAS across the cells tested.
n_reads.title: N Reads

n_reads_comparison.description: Reads at this PAS within comparison_cluster specifically, if pairwise.
n_reads_comparison.title: N Reads Comparison

n_reads_subject.description: Reads at this PAS within canonical_cluster specifically.
n_reads_subject.title: N Reads Subject

odds_ratio.description: Fisher-strategy only; kept for parity with the real per-comparison TSV column.
odds_ratio.title: Odds Ratio

pas_uid.description: Content-addressed PAS id; join key into PasLedgerRow for coordinates/tier/provenance.
pas_uid.title: Pas Uid

utr_class.description: Tandem UTR / alternative-last-exon / etc., from --isoform-agg per_isoform resolution. Gated on E5 landing; None until available.
utr_class.title: Utr Class

title: FindingRow
